text:
Zara P.: hi team :wave: super excited to join! quick Q on Notion templates: i want to suggest a small change to the 'Feature Launch Checklist' (add a step for observability hooks). What's the preferred flow so i don't accidentally change the master template?

Tara (DevEx): welcome @Zara P.! :tada: preferred flow: duplicate the template -> make changes in your duplicate -> add a short "Proposed changes" section at the top -> post the link in this channel with a 1-line rationale. If it's editorial, docs curators will merge; if it touches infra/ops, we route to owners. Also use the edit-request form if you need temporary edit rights: https://forms.redwood.com/notion-edit-request

Mikhail (Docs): extra detail on the "Proposed changes" block we expect: short bullet list + compatibility note. Example header we ask people to keep on drafts:

```
Proposed changes: add observability hooks step
Impact: minor, non-breaking
Test plan: link to sample alert rule PR
Owner suggested: Platform/Observability
```

Mikhail (Docs): after you post here, i'll take a quick look and either merge (if it's purely docs) or tag the owner. If you want me to add an owner badge after merge, say so.

Zara P.: perfect. if i point to a GitHub snippet (config for a prometheus job) should i paste it in Notion or link the gist?

Tara (DevEx): link the gist. we avoid pasting long code in master templates. short examples (1-3 lines) are OK inline, but large blocks should live in the repo or a gist and be linked. That keeps the Notion page lightweight and auditable.

Zara P.: also, naming: should i follow the existing team convention? i saw both "[Team] - [DocType] - [Short]" and some pages with slashes. want to match the index.

Mikhail (Docs): use the canonical pattern for drafts: Team/DocType - ShortDesc - draft (e.g., "Platform/Runbook - ObservabilityHooks - draft"). When it graduates we rename to: [Team] - [DocType] - ShortDesc - v#. The slash helps group in the sidebar during editing but the curator will normalize names on promotion.

Zara P.: one last small thing: i'll be offline a lot first week — can people still comment on my draft?

Tara (DevEx): yes, comments and suggestions work regardless. If you want to make sure reviewers see it, add the link in this channel and ping the owner(s). notion-sync-bot will pick up metadata when the draft has the header filled and add it to the "Pending reviews" section of the Onboarding index.
